what: `switchboard bug next`, `job`, `attempts`, `lesson-check`, `signature-check` and `status-row`: choose the next bug, write the repro job then the fix job with the repro test locked, stop after three tries or a repeated diff, and check the one pitfalls line, the search patterns and the status row.
expectations: A fix job is written only after the repro test failed on main with the reported signature.
The fix job's files_allowed excludes the repro test.
The third failed try parks the bug and raises one Waiting on you item; no dollar cap is applied.
A fix with no pitfalls line, or with two, fails the lesson check.
